topPick.name: Accenture
topPick.thesis: Accenture (ACN) is trading at 18.8x P/E, a 40% discount to its sector average of 31.1x; RSI at 70 reflects strong but extended momentum — watch for potential consolidation. Three-month price momentum of +50.0% reflects exceptional institutional accumulation, with EPS growing +46% year-on-year, underpinned by a bullish MACD crossover confirming upward price pressure. Composite score of 77/100 places ACN in the top 1% of S&P 500 constituents across all four analytical strategies, outperforming its sector by +54.6% over the past quarter.
